snippet.title: Warhammer Combat Cards | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
Join the fighting on Armageddon with a new Draft mode, new campaign, and Yarrick and Wazdakka Gutsmek arriving in-game. Download now, and use the code SKULLS26 to access some goodies!

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/

Follow for more Warhammer, more often:

- Sign up for Warhammer+: https://www.warhammerplus.com/
